create_ingredient: create a Sacred Ingredient to define reusable configuration components with nested dependencies
create_experiment: create a Sacred Experiment that composes multiple Ingredients for modular configuration
configure_ingredient: configure an Ingredient using the @ingredient.config decorator to define scoped config values
capture_config: capture config values into a function using the @ingredient.capture decorator for dependency injection
run_automain: run the main experiment function using the @ex.automain decorator as the entry point
